description: Presidential Secretariat - Supply of Electricity, Petroleum Products and Fuel, etc. as an Essential Services
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the President under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It declares specific services (electricity supply, petroleum distribution, and hospital/medical services) to be essential public services. This constitutes a regulatory action that modifies the legal framework and compliance requirements, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments."
